customManagers.description: Bump tool versions pinned as annotated ARGs in the Dockerfile.
Bump tool versions pinned as annotated env vars in GitHub workflows (e.g. hadolint in lint-dockerfile.yml). The github-actions manager only sees `uses:` refs.

packageRules.description: Major version bumps usually require migration steps. Gate them behind manual approval on the dependency dashboard instead of opening PRs automatically.

Auto-merge digest, patch and minor bumps. Uses GitHub's native auto-merge (platformAutomerge), so the PR only lands once the REQUIRED `test` check on main's ruleset passes. A merge that touches the image publishes a new tag, which homelab's Renovate then rolls out.
